name: What is the process for repairing a sliding door leak?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for repairing a sliding door leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our repair process begins with a thorough inspection to identify the exact source of the leak, which might involve water testing. Once diagnosed, we will provide a detailed repair plan and estimate. Repairs can involve clearing drainage, replacing seals or weatherstripping, repairing damaged frames, or addressing stucco/siding issues. After the repair, we conduct final testing to confirm the leak is resolved and clean the work area.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, diagnosis, a repair plan, fixing the identified issue (e.g., seals, frame, drainage), and final water testing.
